title: CorkLanEntry
description: Schema for CorkLan database entries, bridging cultural language elements with machine-readable specifications.

phrase.description: The word, phrase, or term in the local language, slang, or dialect.

language_lane.description: The specific cultural/linguistic category the entry belongs to.

status.description: Governance status of the phrase entry.

region.description: Specific geographic region or locality of usage (e.g. Cork City, West Cork).

when_to_use.description: Guidelines on appropriate usage contexts (e.g. informal humour).

when_not_to_use.description: Contexts where usage is inappropriate, offensive, or inaccurate.

note.description: Historical, socio-linguistic, or usage nuance notes.

cultural_context_required.description: Flag indicating if LLMs must inject explicit context before serving this phrase.

prohibited_use.description: Forbidden generation or interpretation contexts (e.g. formal judgment, professional profiling).

severity.description: The sensitivity level or social impact rating.

behaviour_tag.description: Machine-readable behavioral annotation (e.g., foolish, greeting, exclamation).

routing_rule.description: Deterministic instruction routing category for AI models.

confidence_score.description: Calculated consensus score from community and speakers.

audit_chain.description: Sequential steps taken (e.g. submitted, reviewed, verified, published).

speaker_verified.description: Indicates if a verified native/heritage speaker has reviewed the entry.

audio_uuid.description: Unique UUID for the audio asset.

archive_source.description: Original archive (e.g., ITMA, Dúchas.ie, Local Recording).

file_url.description: URI to the audio asset hosted in cloud storage (e.g., AWS S3 or Wasabi).
